exercises.question: Which sentence gives a cause? [¿Cuál expresa una causa?]
options: La ciudad cambió debido a la falta de agua. [The city changed due to the lack of water.]
La ciudad cambió por eso. [The city changed as a result.]
La ciudad cambió sin embargo. [The city changed however.]

exercises.sentence: El precio subió, ___ muchas personas cambiaron de plan. (como resultado) [The price went up, as a result many people changed their plans.]

exercises.english: Although it was difficult, we continued.

sentences: Queremos evitar problemas. [We want to avoid problems.]
Estudiamos varias opciones. [We study several options.]
Estudiamos varias opciones para evitar problemas. [We study several options to avoid problems.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines contrast and consequence? [¿Cuál combina contraste y consecuencia?]
options: Era caro; sin embargo, lo compramos, por eso tuvimos que ahorrar. [It was expensive; however, we bought it, so we had to save.]
Era caro. [It was expensive.]
Lo compramos. [We bought it.]

exercises.sentence: El objetivo es ___ buenos resultados. (lograr) [The objective is to achieve good results.]

exercises.english: The measure is useful because it reduces costs.

exercises.question: Which sentence best integrates the unit? [¿Cuál integra mejor la unidad?]
options: El proyecto es necesario porque hay un problema; sin embargo, debe ser económico para que pueda funcionar. [The project is necessary because there is a problem; however, it must be economical so that it can work.]
El proyecto existe. [The project exists.]
Hay un problema. [There is a problem.]

exercises.sentence: El precio subió; como resultado, cambiamos de plan.
options: The price went up; as a result, we changed our plan.
The price went down; however, we stayed.
The price stayed the same.

exercises.sentence: A pesar de las dificultades, continuamos.
options: Despite the difficulties, we continued.
Because of the difficulties, we stopped.
There were no difficulties.

exercises.sentence: Es importante encontrar una solución para que todos puedan participar.

options: Ocurrió debido a la falta de transporte. [It happened due to the lack of transport.]
Ocurrió por eso mañana. [It happened therefore tomorrow.]
Ocurrió sin embargo. [It happened however.]
Como resultado, tuvimos que cambiar de plan. [As a result, we had to change our plan.]
Debido a resultado. [Due to result.]
Aunque resultado. [Although result.]
El objetivo es mejorar el servicio. [The objective is to improve the service.]
El objetivo es por eso. [The objective is therefore.]
El objetivo es sin embargo. [The objective is however.]

exercises.question: Which sentence best shows a balanced argument? [¿Cuál muestra mejor un argumento equilibrado?]
options: La solución es cara; sin embargo, puede lograr buenos resultados y proteger el entorno. [The solution is expensive; however, it can achieve good results and protect the environment.]
La solución es cara, por eso es mala. [The solution is expensive, so it is bad.]
La solución es buena. [The solution is good.]

template.prompt: Explain a problem using cause and consequence.
template.answer: Había poco transporte, por eso muchas personas tuvieron problemas.

template.prompt: Write a short connected argument using cause, contrast, purpose and consequence.
template.answer: El proyecto es necesario porque hay un problema. Sin embargo, debe ser económico para que pueda funcionar. Por lo tanto, debemos buscar una solución equilibrada.
